import hashlib,json,struct,urllib.request,uuid
root=Path('_bin/aac-thread-origin-modules');entries=json.loads((root/'codeview.json').read_text())
def fetch(entry):
 url='https://msdl.microsoft.com/download/symbols/'+entry['pdb']+'/'+entry['key']+'/'+entry['pdb']
 cached=root/entry['pdb']
 if cached.exists():data=cached.read_bytes()
 else:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=30) as response:data=response.read(128*1024**2+1)
 assert len(data)<=128*1024**2 and data.startswith(b'Microsoft C/C++ MSF 7.00')
 block,_,total,directory_bytes,_,block_map=struct.unpack_from('<IIIIII',data,32)
 assert block in (512,1024,2048,4096) and total*block==len(data)
 count=(directory_bytes+block-1)//block;directory_blocks=struct.unpack_from('<'+'I'*count,data,block_map*block)
 directory=b''.join(data[b*block:(b+1)*block] for b in directory_blocks)[:directory_bytes]
 stream_count=struct.unpack_from('<I',directory)[0];sizes=struct.unpack_from('<'+'I'*stream_count,directory,4);at=4+stream_count*4;streams=[]
 for size in sizes:
  count=0 if size==0xffffffff else (size+block-1)//block
  blocks=struct.unpack_from('<'+'I'*count,directory,at) if count else ();at+=count*4
  streams.append(b''.join(data[b*block:(b+1)*block] for b in blocks)[:size] if size!=0xffffffff else b'')
 info=streams[1];age=struct.unpack_from('<I',info,8)[0];guid=uuid.UUID(bytes_le=info[12:28]).hex.upper()
 dbi_age=struct.unpack_from('<I',streams[3],8)[0]
 assert guid==entry['guid'] and age>=entry['age'] and dbi_age==entry['age'],(guid,age,dbi_age,entry)
 path=root/entry['pdb'];path.write_bytes(data)
 return dict(**entry,url=url,bytes=len(data),pdbSha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),guidAndAgeVerified=True,pdbInfoAge=age,dbiAge=dbi_age,matchingRuleSource='https://github.com/microsoft/microsoft-pdb/blob/master/PDB/dbi/pdb.cpp')
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:rows=list(pool.map(fetch,entries))
(root/'symbols.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,struct,uuid
folder=Path('_bin/aac-thread-origin-modules');manifest=json.loads((folder/'symbols.json').read_text());rows=[]
wanted={('ntdll.dll',0x75bc0),('combase.dll',0x122050)}
p=Path('_bin/aac-thread-origin-results/thread-observations.json')
if p.exists():
 for row in json.loads(p.read_text()):
  for t in row.get('inventory',{}).get('threads',[]):
   if t.get('module','').lower() in ('ntdll.dll','combase.dll'):wanted.add((t['module'].lower(),int(t['offset'],16)))
for entry in manifest:
 raw=(folder/entry['pdb']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==entry['pdbSha256']
 block,_,total,dirbytes,_,blockmap=struct.unpack_from('<IIIIII',raw,32);count=(dirbytes+block-1)//block;blocks=struct.unpack_from('<'+'I'*count,raw,blockmap*block)
 directory=b''.join(raw[b*block:(b+1)*block] for b in blocks)[:dirbytes];n=struct.unpack_from('<I',directory)[0];sizes=struct.unpack_from('<'+'I'*n,directory,4);at=4+4*n;lists=[]
 for size in sizes:
  count=0 if size==0xffffffff else (size+block-1)//block;lists.append(struct.unpack_from('<'+'I'*count,directory,at) if count else ());at+=4*count
 def stream(i):return b''.join(raw[b*block:(b+1)*block] for b in lists[i])[:sizes[i]]
 dbi=stream(3);record_stream=struct.unpack_from('<H',dbi,20)[0]
 optbytes=struct.unpack_from('<i',dbi,48)[0];optpos=64+sum(struct.unpack_from('<5i',dbi,24))+struct.unpack_from('<i',dbi,52)[0];options=struct.unpack_from('<'+'H'*(optbytes//2),dbi,optpos)
 assert all(x==0xffff for x in options[3:5]),('OMAP requires explicit mapping',options)
 image=(folder/entry['dll']).read_bytes();pe=struct.unpack_from('<I',image,60)[0];sections=struct.unpack_from('<H',image,pe+6)[0];sectionpos=pe+24+struct.unpack_from('<H',image,pe+20)[0]
 rvas=[struct.unpack_from('<I',image,sectionpos+i*40+12)[0] for i in range(sections)]
 headers=stream(options[5]);assert len(headers)==sections*40
 assert rvas==[struct.unpack_from('<I',headers,i*40+12)[0] for i in range(sections)]
 records=stream(record_stream);symbols=[];pos=0
 while pos<len(records):
  length,kind=struct.unpack_from('<HH',records,pos);assert length>=2 and pos+2+length<=len(records)
  if kind==0x110e:
   flags,offset,section=struct.unpack_from('<IIH',records,pos+4);name=records[pos+14:pos+length+2].split(b'\0')[0].decode(errors='replace')
   if 1<=section<=len(rvas):symbols.append(dict(rva=rvas[section-1]+offset,name=name,recordOffset=pos,flags=flags))
  pos+=length+2
 assert pos==len(records);symbols.sort(key=lambda s:s['rva'])
 for dll,rva in sorted(wanted):
  if dll!=entry['dll']:continue
  exact=[s for s in symbols if s['rva']==rva]
  nearest=max((s for s in symbols if s['rva']<=rva),key=lambda s:s['rva'])
  rows.append(dict(dll=dll,offset=hex(rva),exactSymbols=exact,nearest=nearest,displacement=rva-nearest['rva'],source='PDB S_PUB32 records, no OMAP, PE section RVAs verified',dllSha256=entry['sha256'],pdbSha256=entry['pdbSha256'],symRecordStream=record_stream,recordCount=len(symbols)))
(folder/'parsed-symbols.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))

"""Read-only inventory around the unchanged strict 17-case Classic suite."""
import hashlib,importlib,json,os,sys,time,traceback
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];sys.dont_write_bytecode=True;os.environ['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE']='1'
sdk=root/'_bin/aac-sdk184-classic-fixed-stage/integration';sys.path[:0]=[str(sdk),str(root/'tests')]
for name in ('progressive_schema','progressive_client','progressive_integrity','progressive_resources','progressive_sdk','progressive_v2','progressive_continuous','progressive_windows','progressive_preview','progressive_writer'):
 m=importlib.import_module(name);assert Path(m.__file__).resolve().parent==sdk
import progressive_continuous_aac_heartbeat_stress as stress
import progressive_aac_package_test as driver
from progressive_thread_observation import windows_thread_inventory
report=root/'_bin/aac-thread-origin-results';report.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
original=stress.exercise;original_sample=stress.sample;owned=set();samples=[];began=time.monotonic()
def save(name,value):(report/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
def observed_sample(pid):
 assert pid in owned,'Only explicitly owned test players may be inspected'
 started=time.monotonic();metrics=original_sample(pid);read_finished=time.monotonic()
 entry=dict(ordinal=len(samples),seconds=started-began,metricReadFinishedSeconds=read_finished-began,metrics=metrics,pid=pid)
 try:entry['inventory']=windows_thread_inventory(pid)
 except Exception:entry['inventoryError']=traceback.format_exc()
 samples.append(entry);save('thread-observations',samples)
 return metrics
stress.sample=observed_sample
def observed(peers,work,output,**options):
 owned.update(p.process.pid for p in peers)
 save('inputs',dict(pids=sorted(owned),strictSuiteSha256=stress.sha(stress.__file__),observerSha256=stress.sha(root/'tests/progressive_thread_observation.py'),privateDriverSha256=stress.sha(__file__),helperSha256=stress.sha(root/'tests/progressive_continuous_heartbeat_conformance.py')))
 try:return original(peers,work,output,**options)
 finally:
  # This follows the strict result; no wait can turn its failure into a pass.
  idle=[];idle_began=time.monotonic()
  for index in range(25):
   if index:time.sleep(5)
   row=dict(seconds=time.monotonic()-idle_began,players=[])
   for peer in peers:
    row['players'].append(dict(pid=peer.process.pid,metrics=original_sample(peer.process.pid),inventory=windows_thread_inventory(peer.process.pid)))
   idle.append(row);save('idle-after-result',idle)
  stress.sample=original_sample
stress.exercise=observed
sys.argv=[str(root/'tests/progressive_aac_package_test.py'),'--edition','classic','--scenario','aac-heartbeat','--player',str(root/'_bin/aac-sdk184-classic-fixed-stage/FoxicMP64.exe'),'--sdk-directory',str(sdk),'--reader-runner',str(root/'_bin/continuous-aac-qt-windows/foxicmp-progressive-reader-tests.exe'),'--report-directory',str(report)]
driver.main()
